subject: Vessel Movement Plan for the next 48 Hrs. 11-May-2026
narrative:
All,

Please see the below Vessel Movement plan for next 48hrs.:


Allianz Juno…



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Shuaiba Port. Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.
  *   Tomorrow 12th May, Vessel will sail 1st Trip to Rig Oriental Dragon-1 via NSBP with COSL Crew Change Pax, ETD from Shuaiba Port at 07.30hrs.
  *   Tomorrow 12th May, Vessel will sail 2nd Run to Rig Oriental Phoenix with cargo, ETD 13.00hrs., Vessel will return to Shuaiba Port & STBY at Shuaiba Port.



 Crest Argus 1…



  *   Vessel currently STBY at Rig Oriental Dragon-1, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Dragon-1.
  *   Tomorrow 12th May, Vessel will sail to Shuaiba Port, ETD 14.00 Hrs.


Crest Argus 3…



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Rig Oriental Phoenix, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.
  *   Tomorrow 12th May, Vessel will remain STBY at Oriental Phoenix.



Crest Argus 5….



  *   Vessel Currently STBY at Shuaiba Port, Vessel will remain STBY at Shuaiba Port.
  *   Tomorrow 12th May, Vessel will sail to Rig Oriental Dragon-1, ETD 10.00hrs.



Crew change details will be sent by Rig Logistics/ Aisha/ Ahmed Modather.



Gary,

Kindly approve the above Vessel Movement Plan.
